messages:
alex_g: quick ping — PR #9073 open for conn-pool backoff tweak. can someone take a look? canary showed a p99 bump ~150ms after rollout. need a fast review + decision to merge or rollback. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9073 :pray:

maya_k: looking now. do we have the canary graphs? which cluster/region?

alex_g: canary is eu-west-1, conn-proxy service. grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/conn-proxy/connpool?orgId=1&var-cluster=eu-west-1 — spike starts at 2025-11-03T02:10Z when 5% canary rolled.

samir: CI and e2e are green? pinging ci-bot for status.

ci-bot: PR #9073 — checks: unit-tests ✔️ integration-tests ✔️ e2e (conn-proxy) ❌ (timeout on test: backend-connection-retry).

leo_t: quick skim — change reduces backoff floor, I can see how that could increase head-of-line. minor nit in comments but otherwise okay. wouldn't merge without canary rollback plan.

alex_g: noted. rollback plan: revert to previous backoff settings and canary 5% -> 0% then 100% rollback if regression persists. rollback command I tested in staging: `kubectl set env deploy/conn-proxy PROXY_BACKOFF_MS=200` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/conn-proxy`.

maya_k: thanks. can we add a canary-watch runbook in the PR description (what dashboards to watch, alert thresholds)?

alex_g: added runbook snippet to PR now. also added the perf panel and the exact timestamps.

jamie: FYI we have a maintenance window tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. if this needs a full rollback/merge that touches traffic >50%, prefer we do it in the window. otherwise keep it to canary adjustments.

leo_t: +1 on waiting for maintenance window for large rollbacks. if it's just reverting the env var and restarting canary, can we do that outside window with a 30m watch?

samir: I can be on watch for 45m after rollback. alex — can you open a pager if p99 > 200ms in any region? set temporary alert at 190ms.

alex_g: will do. creating temporary alert now. link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/connpool-p99-temp.

ci-bot: deployment dry-run passed in eu-west-1. canary deployment jobs succeeded.

maya_k: I've posted a short review with one small code comment about metric names. overall looks fine to me.

leo_t: giving an approval, leaving one nit. @alex_g — please squash fixups and re-run CI then we can either merge during maintenance or roll back to previous config if the spike continues. :thumbsup:

alex_g: thanks all. I will: 1) squash & push, 2) re-run CI, 3) if CI green, hold merge until midnight window OR trigger rollback if p99 >190ms in next 30m. posting status here once CI finishes.

ci-bot: PR #9073 — all checks passed.

alex_g: CI green. holding merge until maintenance window per @jamie. if the canary degrades further before then I'll trigger rollback and post here.

samir: copy. I'll keep monitoring and will notify if alert fires.

jamie: thanks team. appreciate the quick eyes. :heart:

leo_t: good coordination. noted the runbook in the PR which will help postmortem if needed.
